title: 八阵图
author: 杜甫
intro: Twenty characters on Zhuge Liang: his genius split China into three, his stone battle-maze still stands in the Yangtze — and so does his one great regret.
analysis: 这首诗也是写诸葛亮的。八阵图是诸葛亮创造的一种军事阵法，传说他在长江边的鱼复浦用石头摆过八阵图的遗迹。第一、二句赞美他的功业：他的功劳超过了所有人，帮刘备建立了三国鼎立（像鼎的三只脚一样三方并立）的局面；他的名声也因为八阵图而更加响亮。第三句写眼前景：江水日夜冲刷，这些石头却一块也没有被冲走。石头不动，象征诸葛亮的忠心和功业永远不变。第四句写他的遗憾：刘备不听劝告，执意去攻打吴国，结果大败，破坏了联吴抗魏的大计，这成了诸葛亮一生的遗恨。短短二十个字，有赞美，有景物，也有惋惜。
analysisEn: This is another poem about Zhuge Liang. The Eightfold Formation was a battle array he is said to have devised, and on a sandbank of the Yangtze near Kuizhou there were rows of stones traditionally believed to be his layout of it. The first couplet praises him: his achievements outshone everyone's in an age when the empire was split three ways, and the Eightfold Formation made his name. The third line turns to what Du Fu can actually see: the river rushes past day and night, yet the stones have not been rolled away. Their stubbornness becomes a picture of Zhuge Liang's unshakeable loyalty and lasting fame. The last line names the regret that endures like the stones. Zhuge Liang's grand strategy depended on alliance with the kingdom of Wu against the stronger Wei; but his ruler Liu Bei insisted on attacking Wu, was crushed, and the plan was ruined. In just twenty characters the poem moves from praise, to landscape, to sorrow.
background: Du Fu (712–770) wrote this around 766, soon after arriving in Kuizhou (today's Fengjie, Chongqing), near the stone formation on the Yangtze traditionally linked to Zhuge Liang (181–234). The last line has been read in more than one way; the reading above is the one most textbooks follow.
pronunciation: 三分 fēn；阵 zhèn；不转 zhuǎn；遗恨 yí。
version: 采用通行教材版本，无重要异文。末句“遗恨失吞吴”历来有几种理解，通行解释为“以刘备攻吴失策为遗恨”。

lines.lit: His merit covered a land split in three;
lines.en: His deeds outshone all in a land split three ways;

lines.lit: his name was made by the Eightfold Formation.
lines.en: the Eightfold Formation made his name.

lines.lit: The river flows, the stones do not turn;
lines.en: The river runs on; the stones will not roll —

lines.lit: left regret: the mistake of trying to swallow Wu.
lines.en: nor will his regret for the war on Wu.

words.note: 诸葛亮创造的作战阵法；“阵”现代汉语有“阵地”“阵容”。
这里是“超过”；现代汉语“盖”多指“盖住”“盖房子”，“盖世无双”还保留古义。
指魏、蜀、吴三国鼎立；成语“三分天下”“三足鼎立”今天仍常用。
江水冲不走石头，暗用《诗经》“我心匪石，不可转也”（我的心不是石头，不能转动），象征坚定。
留下来的遗憾；现代汉语说“遗憾”，“遗恨”比较书面。

words.en: the mistake of trying to conquer Wu
words.note: “失”是失策、做错；“吞”是吞并，现代汉语也说“吞并”。
三国之一，在长江下游；今天“吴”还是江苏南部一带的别称，如“吴语”。

imagery.name: 长江
imagery.zh: 日夜奔流的长江代表时间流逝，几百年过去了，一切都在变。
imagery.en: The Yangtze, flowing day and night, stands for time passing and everything changing.
